announcements.headline: Cancellation - THE CO-OPERATIVE BANK HOLDINGS PLC
announcements.insight: The Co-operative Bank Finance Plc cancels its 2028 Notes following the May 2026 pricing and tender results. This concludes the debt instrument lifecycle initiated earlier this month.

announcements.headline: Notice to holders of outstanding Notes
announcements.insight: The Co-operative Bank Finance Plc issues a notice to holders of outstanding Notes following its May 2026 pricing and tender results. Shareholders should monitor for further developments regarding these debt instruments.

announcements.headline: 2028 Notes Pricing and Results of Tender Offers
announcements.insight: The Co-operative Bank Finance PLC announces pricing and results for its 2028 Notes tender offers. This action impacts holders of these specific debt instruments.
